ai.title: How AI Is Dismantling the Attention Economy and What Comes Next
ai.description: Google's global search market share fell below 90% for the first time in a decade in late 2024, dropping from a peak of 92.9% in 2023 to 89.54% by July 2025. The publisher damage is not theoretical. Forbes experienced a 50% year-on-year decline in traffic in July 2025. CNN's monthly visits fell from approximately 440 million to around 315 million in the same period. Business Insider, The Huffington Post, and NBC News all saw declines of 40% or more. The median publisher recorded a 10% year-on-year decline in the first half of 2025.
